reference_notes: C01 source shapes and three cards retained; normal density policy is the explicit 0.8 correction
WP-11 enables TAR/TAR.GZ; TAR disables levels, both disable password/volumes; pending directory bytes are not fabricated
Selected-input count and empty-state layout are functional additions
Native OS titlebar is outside client bounds; body may scroll on short screens

summary_fixture.unit: Decimal SI for creation selection summary; sizes are read on the metadata worker

reviewed_changes: Circular minus removal, shared borders/radii and continuous segmented radio group follow C01
Footer buttons use one role component across operation windows
Information uses commas or line breaks; original bitmaps remain immutable
2026-10-15 border correction: light neutral control border changes from #C9D1E0 to #DCE2EC. Original C01 pixels and hash remain unchanged; dark #485469 and semantic states are retained.

border_review.method: Median RGB along straight source edges, excluding corner antialiasing and text. Original raster has resampling noise; do not treat its physical stroke width as a logical width.
border_review.scope: Neutral input, select, segmented group, normal button, footer button and unselected settings card borders. Card, menu, accent, error and danger roles retain their own colors.
